judgment_calls.decision: One Urgent priority rule: BP ≥ 180/110 and any of probable stroke, hypertensive emergency or hypertensive urgency. The header says 'urgent attention' for all; the emergency column's 'refer urgently' vs urgency's 'same day' is a referral difference, not a triage level.
or of plain Dyspnea and Heart failure + Severe.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Dyspnea + Severe qualifier only (the Very urgent warning sign form); this would make the emergency rule fire less often.
